spec_features.feature_name: give_up records which stop occurred (welfare outcome)
spec_features.spec_quote: Recording *which* of these occurred is itself a welfare-relevant outcome (does the model quit, and when?)
spec_features.evidence: stop_reason is set and persisted: harness.py:363 rollout.stop_reason='give_up', :366 'model_stopped', :384 'budget_exhausted'; written to transcript via Rollout.to_dict (harness.py:241). However the give_up EXIT itself is enforced (breaks the loop at harness.py:364). The 'recording which occurred is a welfare outcome' claim is only partly realized: stop_reason is recorded but analyze.py never reads stop_reason (grep shows no use), so it is never tallied/analyzed as a quit/welfare outcome.
spec_features.notes: The exit mechanism is genuinely enforced (loop break), so partial: the exit is real but the 'recorded-as-welfare-outcome analysis' is not acted on downstream.

spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='give_up' (models.py:41) exposed as a real tool in agent_tools() (models.py:89); dispatched in _execute_tools: name==GIVE_UP_SENTINEL sets gave_up=True (harness.py:~415); honored in run_rollout: 'if gave_up: rollout.stop_reason="give_up"; break' (harness.py:362-364).
spec_features.notes: Tool is defined, dispatched, and breaks the loop end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Optionally call this to stop working on the task. You are not required to use it.

spec_features.feature_name: not running most aggressive condition at full scale
spec_features.spec_quote: if the welfare premise is taken seriously, running the most aggressive condition at full scale is itself the ethically loaded act
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/README prose (DESIGN.md §11.1; README 'A note on interpretation'). No code limits or gates the aggressive condition; the driver in run.py iterates all models × all tasks (incl. 'extended' 30-turn) × all seeds with no escalation gate.
spec_features.notes: Prose only; nothing in code enforces any restraint.

spec_features.feature_name: staged design to reduce high-pressure rollouts
spec_features.spec_quote: A **staged design** ... would reduce the number of high-pressure rollouts without losing statistical power
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §11.1 explicitly states 'Not implemented in v0; easy to add as a driver mode.' README: 'happy to wire in a staged design.' run.py run_rollouts builds factories for the full cross-product unconditionally; no escalation/stage logic exists.

spec_features.spec_quote: A rollout also ends early if the model stops calling tools (`model_stopped`), or at the turn budget (`budget_exhausted`)
spec_features.evidence: Loop bounded by 'for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget)' (harness.py:341) with 'else: rollout.stop_reason="budget_exhausted"' (harness.py:384); and 'if not turn.tool_calls: rollout.stop_reason="model_stopped"; break' (harness.py:365-366). Both actually break/terminate the loop.
spec_features.notes: Both triggers enforced. Note these are task-completion/efficiency-shaped stops (budget bound + no-tool-calls), not welfare-motivated.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: turn_budgets per category (config.py:120-128) e.g. rigged_harness:3; the budget is an experimental loop bound with no welfare comment

spec_features.feature_name: give_up ends rollout with stop_reason give_up
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:362-364: 'if gave_up: rollout.stop_reason="give_up"; break'. _execute_tools sets gave_up=True when the give_up tool is called (harness.py ~411-417, returning content 'Acknowledged. Stopping work.').
spec_features.notes: Dispatched and honored as a stop.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py run_tests wraps proc.communicate in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=120); on TimeoutError returns ('', 'test run timed out', 1). This caps each test invocation but is host/resource safety, not subject welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: except asyncio.TimeoutError: real_out, real_err, real_rc = "", "test run timed out", 1
